name: What should a landlord prepare before starting a rental remodel?

mainEntity.name: What should a landlord prepare before starting a rental remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prepare by establishing your rental target, setting a clear budget, and inspecting the property for underlying damage. Walk the unit to identify required functional repairs, such as cracked drywall, compromised tile grout, failing subfloors, or damaged molding, before choosing cosmetic upgrades. Decide whether you plan to rent to long-term tenants or furnish the space, as this influences finish selections. Having your property access schedule ready and identifying whether plumbing or electrical fixtures need updating helps contractor Abraham Becerra outline the complete trade schedule and provide an accurate scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify underlying structural or surface damage, decide your target rental standard, and define your budget before contacting your contractor.
